source_preconditions: Grid v2 existing managed loopback source and startup identity
original 1m closed source records validated via Grid qualify_records
exact single producer identity/source revision/epoch and same symbol
source window has exactly width * bars consecutive unique 1m starts, aligned and fully closed
all source event end clocks <= cutoff; no cross future bar, no partial current bar
source 1m may be PARTIAL only, never GAP/STALE/UNAVAILABLE for data output
numeric_policy: Original Math 9e6 exact_sum and executed_volume_delta only. Grid PR305 derives delta from exact directional Decimal sums BEFORE binary64 DTO conversion; consumer MUST NOT recompute delta from displayed buy/sell floats (catastrophic cancellation).
output_policy: derived observation only, exchange_completeness NOT_ATTESTED, quality and source_authenticity NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_ATTESTED, paper_admitted false and execution_authority false
handoff: Grid PR305 historical source-only 5m/15m and LIVE rollup; Terminan PR130 consumes the sole Grid LIVE rollup and removes duplicate 1m aggregation. Math PR167 is CLOSED UNMERGED: use original Math baseline exclusively. B owns historical source; D owns historical chart adapter and accurate delta semantic; H owns independent tests and coverage.

source_requirements: Explicit UTC-aligned before_ms and as_of_ms, 0 < before_ms <= as_of_ms <= now_ms, separation <=30 days
Every source_event_end_ms and ingestion_ms <= as_of_ms and each closed 1m row before before_ms
All 1m rows GOOD, unique, continuous, one epoch/revision/identity, no missing 5m/15m bucket
No stored point-in-time snapshot, no provider source authentication or completeness attestation
Never downgrade old LIVE STALE to PARTIAL without distinct explicit historical-as-of endpoint
All execution_authority, trading_authorized, paper_admitted false and immutable false
historical_asof.consumer: Terminan PR130 LIVE only; D-owned historical chart adapter is separately required and NOT_IMPLEMENTED

delta_presentation: Grid binary64 buy/sell may be equal while legitimate source-derived Grid delta is nonzero; D must validate delta as a bounded finite signed value with producer provenance and original parent fingerprint, not demand float(executed_volume_delta(Decimal(str(rounded_buy)),Decimal(str(rounded_sell)))) equality.
